scheme_name: Providing Scholarships to Children of BOC Workers
other_conditions: Must be a registered worker with the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Children must not be enrolled under Chandranna Bima.
Student must be studying in classes 9‑12, ITI, or professional courses at the graduation level.
Each family can receive scholarships for up to two children.
Application must be submitted within three months from the start of the academic year.
benefits_summary: Scholarships of ₹1,200 per year for 9th‑12th grade/ITI students and ₹5,000 per year for graduation‑level professional courses.
